## Kind of change

- [ ] Editorial or documentation only (no change in meaning)
- [ ] Normative: changes what an implementation must or may do (needs an accepted proposal issue)
- [ ] Reference code or conformance suite
- [ ] Website

## Checklist

- [ ] Fictional data only (`.test` domains, `TEST-` license numbers); no real person, firm or case
- [ ] Normative change: schema change, fictional example and conformance test included, changelog updated
- [ ] No published file edited in place (0.1 text and schemas stay byte-identical)
- [ ] No existing conformance check weakened, skipped or removed
- [ ] `(cd protocol && npm test)`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run scan` pass locally
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin)
